plain: The Model Spec's top level: rules that nothing in a conversation can override.
eli5: The house rules nobody visiting can change, not even the babysitter.
technical: The highest Model Spec authority level, held only by Root-badged spec sections (no message role sits there), so no system, developer or user message can override it; it is not the same as Claude's hard constraints, since many Root sections are not prohibitions, and the Model Spec's red lines are the closer match.
